meta.app: CK2 Art Bot pack_atlas_r5.py (TexturePacker JSON Hash compatible)
meta.layerSpec: 8-bit RGBA, unlit, LINEAR, NOT premultiplied. Four mutually exclusive paint regions (dominant region wins the whole pixel; value = paint fraction, so AA only against non-paint): R = primary (+deck, +helmet shell), G = secondary (nose, wing belly/trailing edge/caps, sideboard bands, front-wing boards, belly pan, wheel mud covers = the "rims"), B = number panel (wing top + both sideboards), STRIPE = 1 - A (hood stripe, side bands, arm-guard bands, wicker bill, helmet stripe). A = 255 everywhere that is not stripe (incl. empty space). Coverage is NOT in the mask any more: use the albedo alpha (identical frame rects).
meta.pivotMeaning: ground point directly under the rear-axle centre; same pixel in every frame of every layer
meta.heading0: nose pointing up the screen, away from the grandstand, increasing clockwise
meta.steerNote: front-wheel yaw; + = wheels turned to the car's left (CCW from above)
meta.frameOrder: index = headingIndex*5 + steerIndex (steer order L2,L1,C,R1,R2); page = index // framesPerPage; same order in every layer
meta.keyLight: R4 scene, fixed for all frames: key sun 3.8 (12 deg disc) from screen upper-left ~62 deg high, two large area fill banks, sky 0.6; shadow layer = key sun only
meta.tint: linear: m = mask; stripe = 1 - m.a; rgb = albedo.rgb * mix(1, primary/0.8, m.r) * mix(1, secondary/0.8, m.g) * mix(1, panel/0.8, m.b) * mix(1, stripe/0.8, stripe); alpha = albedo.a; then rgb += specGlint (from the spec layer, added AFTER the tint and NOT tinted)
meta.numberPanelsNote: albedo + mask frames: numberPanels.{wing_top, board_right, board_left}.corners = 4 points in 192 px frame px (origin top-left), order TL,TR,BR,BL in the number reading frame; wing_top reads upright to someone in FRONT of the car (rule-book convention, top of the digits toward the trailing edge); each sideboard number reads front-to-back from its own outside; facing = cos(angle to camera), visible = facing > 0.05. Panel colour = the B tint (all R4 liveries: the primary colour).
meta.gpuFormat: KTX2 UASTC (linear), see ktx2Image; ETC1S/BasisLZ kept as ktx2ImageETC1S
meta.ktx2Note: Ship ktx2Image (UASTC, linear): ETC1S breaks the mutually exclusive regions (see verify_report ktx2.mask). The ETC1S file is kept for comparison only.
